meta.title: AUDENIQ | Music Distribution & Publishing for Independent Artists
meta.description: AUDENIQ is a music platform being prepared in South Korea for independent artists, songwriters and indie labels: digital music distribution, music publishing, release management and royalty reporting. Not yet open for releases.
meta.ogDescription: Your music and your rights, further out into the world. AUDENIQ is preparing music distribution, publishing and label services for independent music.
meta.ogImageAlt: AUDENIQ — Your music. Your rights. Out into the wider world. Preparing for launch

The songs you write,

home.인디 작곡가와 작사가, 직접 곡을 쓰는 아티스트를 위한 음악 퍼블리싱을: We are preparing music publishing for indie composers and lyricists and for artists who write their own songs. Freelance creators without a publisher or agency are welcome too.

home.저작권은 창작자에게 남아요. AUDENIQ는 별도로 합의한 작품과 계약: Your copyrights stay with you. AUDENIQ plans to administer and pitch only the works and contract scope you separately agree to.
home.작품의 다음을 함께 준비해요: Preparing your songs’ next step together

Platform-specific support and required materials will be announced at launch.
home.수익과 정산을 쉽게 확인해요: Revenue and payouts that are easy to follow
home.한국어 고객지원과 월 단위 정산을 준비하고 있어요. 음악 플랫폼이 보고한: We are preparing Korean-language customer support and monthly payouts. We are designing it so you can tell revenue reported by music services apart from confirmed payout statements.
home.Smart Link, Pre-save, Pre-order와 홍보 카드 등: We are preparing tools to announce your release, such as Smart Link, Pre-save, Pre-order and promo cards. Profile issue support, music video releases and rights management will also be available as optional add-ons where needed.

We are preparing to let you manage distribution, catalog, rights and royalty accounting together, and later to connect collaboration with creators and other labels.
Music made together, possibilities opened together.
Your music and your data,
kept safe.

Unreleased music and the information

home.AUDENIQ는 개인정보와 음원, 권리 및 정산 정보를 안전하게 관리할: AUDENIQ takes security seriously so that personal data, audio files, rights and royalty information are managed safely.
home.필요한 정보만 수집하고, 정해진 목적에 맞게 사용하며, 허가받지 않은 접: We are preparing safeguards to collect only the information we need, use it only for its stated purpose, and prevent unauthorized access and leaks.
We do not sell personal data
for advertising.
We protect unreleased music
and rights information.
We design access so only users
with the right permissions see data.
We process personal data only
as far as the service requires.

home.음악을 만드는 당신의 이야기가 필요해요: We want to hear your story as a music maker
A new kind of music distribution,
prepared together with you.

What was the hardest part of releasing your music?
From release prep to rights management and checking revenue,
your experience helps shape what AUDENIQ does next.
home.아직 발매 경험이 없어도 좋아요.<br class=\"mobile-bre: No release experience yet? That’s fine too.<br class="mobile-break"> Tell us what you need for your first release.
Sign-up and applications for distribution and publishing are not open yet.
home.AUDENIQ(어데닉)는 대한민국에서 출시를 준비 중인 독립 아티스트,: AUDENIQ (Korean name: 어데닉) is a music platform for independent artists, songwriters and labels that is preparing to launch in South Korea. Built around music distribution in Korea and internationally, it is preparing services that connect music publishing, catalog and revenue management, and release support.
home.AUDENIQ는 음원 배급 서비스를 준비하고 있지만, 아직 음원 배급을: AUDENIQ is preparing a music distribution service, but it has not started distributing music yet. It is currently preparing to incorporate and to sign contracts with music services (DSPs) in Korea and abroad, and plans to offer music distribution and music publishing as separate services.
home.지금 AUDENIQ에서 음원을 발매하거나 퍼블리싱을 신청할 수 있나요?: Can I release music or sign up for publishing with AUDENIQ now?
home.아직은 신청할 수 없어요. 현재 배급 시스템과 퍼블리싱 서비스의 출시를: Not yet. AUDENIQ is preparing to launch its distribution system and publishing service, and will announce when applications open and what each service supports on its official website and social channels.
home.어떤 음악 플랫폼에 배급할 수 있나요?: Which music platforms can AUDENIQ distribute to?
home.지원 음악 플랫폼은 아직 확정되지 않았어요. 국내 주요 음악 서비스와의: Supported music platforms have not been confirmed yet. AUDENIQ is prioritizing direct contracts with major Korean music services and plans to broaden its reach through direct international contracts and Merlin membership and licensing. Supported platforms and countries will be announced once contracts are confirmed.
home.음원 배급과 음악 퍼블리싱은 어떻게 다른가요?: What is the difference between music distribution and music publishing?
home.음원 배급은 녹음된 음원을 음악 플랫폼에 전달하고 그 이용 수익을 정산하: Music distribution delivers recorded music to music services and pays out the revenue from its use. Music publishing is a separate service that administers royalties for the compositions and lyrics behind a song and pitches them for new uses. AUDENIQ will explain the contract and payout scope of each separately.
home.AUDENIQ Publishing은 무엇이고, 누가 이용할 수 있나요?: What is AUDENIQ Publishing, and who can use it?
home.AUDENIQ Publishing은 작사·작곡 작품의 등록, 저작권료 관: AUDENIQ Publishing is a music publishing service in preparation that will help with registering compositions and lyrics, administering royalties and pitching songs for new uses. It is aimed at indie composers and lyricists, artists who write their own songs and freelance creators; the manageable scope will be set after reviewing existing collecting society or publishing agreements and the rights of each work.
home.배급을 맡기면 권리도 AUDENIQ로 넘어가나요?: If AUDENIQ distributes my music, do my rights transfer to AUDENIQ?
home.기본 배급 계약은 비독점으로 준비하고 있으며, 음원과 작품의 권리는 권리: No. The standard distribution agreement is being prepared on a non-exclusive basis, and rights to recordings and works stay with the rights holders. AUDENIQ receives only the permissions needed for distribution, within the scope of the agreement. Publishing is also a separate service you choose and contract for.
home.기존에 발매한 음원도 옮길 수 있나요?: Can I move music I have already released?
home.기존 ISRC·UPC와 발매 정보를 유지하는 방향으로 배급사 이전 지원을: AUDENIQ is preparing distributor transfer support that keeps existing ISRCs, UPCs and release information. It plans to help you confirm the release and matching status on the new distribution route before ending the previous distributor’s delivery. Whether and how a transfer works depends on existing contracts and each platform’s policies.
home.인디 아티스트와 독립 레이블 모두 이용할 수 있나요?: Can both indie artists and independent labels use AUDENIQ?
home.네. 개인 인디 아티스트의 첫 발매부터 여러 아티스트를 운영하는 독립 레: Yes. AUDENIQ is preparing a service for everyone from an indie artist’s first release to independent labels managing many artists. For labels, it is developing tools to manage catalogs, release schedules and royalty accounting as a team.
home.뮤직비디오와 온라인 영상 속 음원도 관리하나요?: Does AUDENIQ handle music videos and music used in online videos?
home.뮤직비디오의 국내 심의 진행 지원과 글로벌 영상 플랫폼 발매를 준비하고: AUDENIQ is preparing support for the Korean music video rating process and for releasing music videos on global video platforms. Any required rating will go through the external rating body’s procedure. Rights management for music used in online videos, such as YouTube Content ID, is being prepared separately, and support depends on each platform’s and each piece of content’s rights requirements.
home.한국어로 문의하고 정산받을 수 있나요?: Will support and payouts be available in Korean?
home.한국어 고객지원과 국내 이용자를 위한 월 단위 정산 시스템을 준비하고 있: AUDENIQ is preparing Korean-language customer support and a monthly payout system for users in Korea. Statements will follow the music services’ revenue reports and payout confirmation schedules.
home.사전 설문에 참여하면 자동으로 가입되나요?: Does taking the pre-launch survey sign me up?
home.현재 설문은 서비스 기획을 위한 의견 수집이에요. 설문 참여만으로 회원가: No. The current survey only collects feedback for service planning. Taking it does not create an account or a distribution or publishing agreement.
Your music. Your rights.
Out into the wider world.

Questions about the service are welcome by email, too.

pages.title: How is AUDENIQ preparing music distribution for independent artists?
pages.description: AUDENIQ is preparing digital music distribution in Korea and worldwide for independent artists and labels. See the release checks, direct-contract distribution plan, non-exclusive terms, catalog and payouts, and distributor transfers.
pages.question: How will AUDENIQ support music distribution for indie artists?
pages.answer: AUDENIQ is preparing a music distribution service in Korea and internationally for independent artists and independent labels.
facts: Direct contracts with Korean music services first, then direct international contracts and Merlin membership and licensing
Non-exclusive distribution; rights to recordings stay with the rights holders
Monthly payouts following platforms’ revenue reports and payment confirmation

sections.heading: What do I need to check before a release?
paragraphs: You prepare the materials a release needs: audio files, cover art, artist name, track titles and credits, and the release schedule. AUDENIQ is developing a system that checks audio quality and release metadata and tracks distribution status.
Basic artist profile linking, delivery of the lyrics you provide and release promotion tools are also in preparation. Required materials and the scope of support will be announced at launch.

sections.heading: How is the distribution network being built?
paragraphs: AUDENIQ is prioritizing direct contracts with major Korean music services. It then plans to broaden its reach through direct international contracts and Merlin membership and licensing.
Pursuing a contract is not the same as being able to distribute. Supported music platforms and countries will be announced on the official website once contracts are confirmed.

sections.heading: How do I move music I have already released?
paragraphs: AUDENIQ is preparing distributor transfer support that keeps existing ISRCs, UPCs and release information. The plan is to confirm release and matching status on the new distribution route before you end delivery through your previous distributor.

The actual transfer method depends on existing contracts, whether the metadata matches and each music platform’s policies. The approach is to check the new route first, before taking any existing release down.

faq.q: Can I release music through AUDENIQ now?
faq.a: Not yet. AUDENIQ is preparing for launch, and will announce when sign-up and distribution applications open on its official website and social channels.

faq.q: Do my rights transfer to AUDENIQ when it distributes my music?
faq.a: AUDENIQ’s standard distribution is being prepared on a non-exclusive basis. Rights to your recordings stay with the rights holders, and AUDENIQ receives only the permissions needed for distribution within the scope of the agreement.
No. Publishing is a separate service that you choose and contract for on its own. AUDENIQ will explain the scope of distribution and of royalty administration for compositions and lyrics separately.

pages.title: What is music publishing for indie songwriters?
pages.description: AUDENIQ Publishing is a music publishing service in preparation for indie composers, lyricists and artists who write their own songs: song registration, rights data, royalty administration, pitching and a separate opt-in contract.
pages.question: Who is AUDENIQ Publishing for?
pages.answer: AUDENIQ Publishing is being prepared as a music publishing service for indie composers, lyricists and artists who write their own songs.
pages.audience: Indie composers, lyricists, freelance creators and artists who write their own songs
facts: Indie composers and lyricists, artists who write their own songs and freelance creators
Song registration support, rights data, royalty administration and accounting, and sync and placement pitching
Chosen and contracted separately from distribution

sections.heading: How is music distribution different from publishing?
paragraphs: Music distribution delivers recorded music to music services and pays out the revenue from its use. Music publishing administers royalties for the compositions and lyrics behind a song and pitches them for new uses.

Even for the same song, the rights in the recording and in the composition and lyrics must be checked separately. AUDENIQ will explain the contract and payout scope of distribution and publishing separately.

sections.heading: What support is being prepared for songwriters?
paragraphs: AUDENIQ Publishing is preparing a service that organizes information about your works and their rights, and helps with song registration and royalty administration and accounting. Pitching your music for new uses is also part of the plan.

The goal is a service that freelance creators without a publisher or agency can use too. Which works can be administered, and the scope of support, will be decided after reviewing existing agreements and the rights status of each work.

sections.heading: What happens to my copyrights if I sign up for publishing?
paragraphs: AUDENIQ Publishing is being prepared so that copyrights stay with the creator. AUDENIQ plans to administer and pitch only the works and contract scope you separately agree to.

For works already covered by a collecting society mandate or a publishing agreement, that agreement and the rights status must be checked first. It is not a service that guarantees administration of every work.

faq.q: Can freelance composers and lyricists use it?
faq.a: Yes. AUDENIQ Publishing is also being prepared for indie composers, lyricists and freelance creators who work without a publisher or agency.

faq.q: Am I automatically signed up for publishing if I use distribution?
faq.a: No. Publishing is a separate service that you choose and contract for on its own. AUDENIQ is preparing it so that applying for distribution never creates a publishing agreement by itself.

faq.q: Can I bring works that are already under a collecting society or publishing agreement?
faq.a: AUDENIQ will review existing collecting society or publishing agreements and the rights of each work before deciding the scope it can administer.

pages.title: How can independent labels manage releases, catalogs and royalties?
pages.description: AUDENIQ is preparing label services for independent and small labels: several artists’ catalogs and release schedules, team workflows, per-rights-holder royalty accounting, and profile, lyrics and promotion support.
pages.question: How will AUDENIQ support independent label operations?
pages.answer: AUDENIQ is developing a service that lets independent labels manage several artists’ catalogs, release schedules and royalty accounting together.
pages.serviceType: Independent label operations support · in preparation
facts: Independent and small labels managing several artists
Track and artist information, release schedules, distribution status and payout information
Permission-based access and shared task management
Creator connections, label collaboration and release promotion

sections.heading: How can I manage releases for several artists?
paragraphs: AUDENIQ is developing a catalog management system that shows tracks and artist information, release schedules and distribution status in one place. It is meant both for an individual’s first release and for labels running releases for several artists.
The plan is for teams to coordinate their work together, with only users who hold the necessary permissions able to access information.

sections.heading: How can I check revenue and per-rights-holder payouts?
paragraphs: AUDENIQ is preparing a system that keeps platform revenue and confirmed payout statements apart so both are easy to check. It is also being developed to manage payout details for every rights holder you work with.
Monthly payouts and Korean-language customer support are in preparation, and actual payouts will follow the music services’ revenue reports and payment confirmation.

sections.heading: What support is planned after a release?
paragraphs: AUDENIQ is preparing artist profile linking, delivery of the lyrics you provide, and tools to announce a release such as Smart Link, Pre-save, Pre-order and promo cards. Profile issue support, music video releases and rights management for music used in online videos are also being prepared as options where needed.
Later, AUDENIQ plans to expand toward connecting artists, songwriters, lyricists, producers and other labels for collaboration. Timing and platform-specific support will be announced at launch.

faq.a: Yes. AUDENIQ is preparing its services for independent labels, including small labels, as well as individual artists.

faq.q: Do solo artists need to use the label management service?
faq.a: No. Individual artists will be able to use the services they need for their own releases and distribution. Services built around label team operations are designed to be chosen only when needed.

faq.q: Are rights management and publishing included automatically?
faq.a: No. Publishing is a separate service chosen and contracted after checking the rights status of each work. The actual scope of distribution and label support will also each be announced at launch.

pages.title: What kind of music platform is AUDENIQ?
pages.description: AUDENIQ is a music platform being prepared in South Korea for independent artists, songwriters and labels, connecting music distribution, publishing, catalog management and royalty accounting. See its launch status and official contacts.
pages.question: What is AUDENIQ?
pages.answer: AUDENIQ (Korean name: 어데닉) is a music distribution and publishing platform for independent artists, songwriters and labels, being prepared in South Korea.
facts: Music distribution, music publishing, catalog management and royalty accounting

sections.heading: What direction is AUDENIQ taking?
paragraphs: AUDENIQ aims to connect every next step in music, from an individual’s first release to a label’s operations. The plan is to build a distribution base in Korea first and then expand to international distribution.

Music distribution and music publishing are being prepared with separate rights and contract scopes. AUDENIQ respects creators’ rights in their recordings and works and is building services they can choose as needed.

sections.heading: Can I apply or sign a contract now?
paragraphs: AUDENIQ is currently preparing to incorporate, to sign contracts with music platforms and to launch the service. Sign-up and applications for distribution and publishing are not open yet.
Launch timing and supported music platforms and countries will be announced on the official website and social channels once contracts and preparations are complete.

sections.heading: Where can I find official contacts and news?
paragraphs: Service inquiries and partnership proposals go to audeniq.official@gmail.com. Launch news and updates are shared on the official website, the audeniq.official accounts on Instagram and Threads, and @audeniq on X.
